printed_attack_damage.description: Attacks with a readable name and a numeric damage value printed beside that name. Extract the base number, ignoring a trailing + or multiplication symbol. Exclude damage amounts mentioned only in the rules prose and attacks without a numeric damage value beside their name. Return each distinct record once, in any order. Use [] when no complete records are readable; do not reconstruct missing text.

base_damage.description: Numeric base damage printed beside the attack name, without modifiers.

calamitous_slash_damaged_target_damage.description: Damage from Calamitous Slash when the opposing Active Pokémon already has damage counters, with no Weakness, Resistance, or other modifiers.
